sections.title: Production Server
sections.content:
Setting up a production server with Uvicorn:

```python
# main.py
import uvicorn
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/")
def read_root():
    return {"Hello": "World"}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run("main:app", host="0.0.0.0", port=8000, reload=False)

# Running with Gunicorn
# gunicorn main:app -w 4 -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker -b 0.0.0.0:8000
```

sections.title: Docker Setup
sections.content:
Containerizing the application with Docker:

```dockerfile
# Dockerfile
FROM python:3.9

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

# docker-compose.yml
version: '3'

services:
  web:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@db:5432/dbname
    depends_on:
      - db

  db:
    image: postgres:13
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=user
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=password
      - POSTGRES_DB=dbname
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

volumes:
  postgres_data:
```

sections.title: Environment Variables
Cloud Deployment
sections.content:
Deploying to cloud platforms:

```yaml
# AWS Elastic Beanstalk
# .elasticbeanstalk/config.yml
branch-defaults:
  main:
    environment: my-fastapi-env

global:
  application_name: my-fastapi-app
  default_ec2_keyname: null
  default_platform: Python 3.9
  default_region: us-west-2
  include_git_submodules: true
  instance_profile: null
  platform_name: null
  platform_version: null
  profile: null
  sc: git
  workspace_type: Application

# Google Cloud Run
# cloudbuild.yaml
steps:
- name: 'gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker'
  args: ['build', '-t', 'gcr.io/$PROJECT_ID/my-fastapi-app', '.']
- name: 'gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker'
  args: ['push', 'gcr.io/$PROJECT_ID/my-fastapi-app']
- name: 'gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk'
  entrypoint: gcloud
  args:
  - 'run'
  - 'deploy'
  - 'my-fastapi-app'
  - '--image'
  - 'gcr.io/$PROJECT_ID/my-fastapi-app'
  - '--region'
  - 'us-central1'
  - '--platform'
  - 'managed'

# Heroku
# Procfile
web: uvicorn main:app --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
```
